scripts.install:all: npm --prefix flight-booking-system/backend install && npm --prefix flight-booking-system/frontend install
scripts.build: npm --prefix flight-booking-system/backend run build && npm --prefix flight-booking-system/frontend run build
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm --prefix flight-booking-system/backend run dev" "npm --prefix flight-booking-system/frontend run dev"
scripts.start: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm --prefix flight-booking-system/backend run start" "npm --prefix flight-booking-system/frontend run start"
